Kim / Rishi / Sean — thanks for the heads up. From a Finance/KYC perspective we need the following to move the vendor record and release the PO: 

- Signed W-9 with the new legal name (we have the PDF but need to validate the EIN string).
- Articles of Amendment or Secretary of State filing confirming the name/EIN change (we have the attachment; thank you).
- A short letter on company letterhead confirming the effective date of the EIN change (signed by CFO/CEO) OR a DocuSign envelope that we can countersign to acknowledge.
- Confirmation of whether banking details changed; if ACH changed, we require a bank letter or voided check for ACH validation.

Rishi — can Tax run an EIN cross-check (IRS/TIN verification or equivalent) and confirm whether the EIN on the W-9 matches public filings? If we get positive verification we can proceed to reassign PO-45321 to the new entity and update payment terms.

Nicole — we prefer a DocuSign letter if you can send it; here is a template note you can paste and sign: "To whom it may concern: Effective Nov 15, 2027, LumenWorks LLC changed its legal name to LumenWorks Inc. The EIN for the new entity is XX-XXXXXXX. This change does not affect existing contracts; please update your vendor record accordingly."

I'll hold PO-45321 in pending state until Rishi confirms.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

I pulled the attachments and did an initial EIN match against the Secretary of State filing and the public TIN directory. The EIN provided on the W-9 (XX-XXXXXXX) matches the filing in CA for LumenWorks Inc. I still need a scanned proof of the bank account if ACH details changed — for ACH changes we'll require either: 

1) bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account and routing (preferred), or
2) voided check + signed ACH authorization form.

If LumenWorks confirms that banking details did NOT change and only the legal name/EIN changed, we can move forward with vendor record update after we receive the short confirmation letter on company letterhead. Once I confirm the number against IRS/TIN, I'll post the verification note in the vendor record.

I'll update the ticket when complete.
